description: Use when the user asks: 'show me the rights chain for X', 'give me everything on this song', 'what's the full picture for X?', 'trace the chain from this writer to that work'. Graph lookup — resolves a query, ISWC, or ISRC to its full rights chain in one call. Each result bundles the work, its writers and publishers (names + roles, no IPIs or splits), the linked recording (ISRC, DSP presence, duration), and audio characteristics (BPM, key, energy). Prefer over stitching list_works + lookup_work + lookup_person when you want the whole graph around a track in a single round-trip. Supports audio-only queries (min_bpm, key, mood, etc.) when you don't have a text query. Work results carry programmable_since (every owner confirmed a locked split) and ready_to_license (composition and a master confirmed, with audio, ISRC and ISWC); filter to either with programmable_only / ready_to_license. → then: directory_lookup_work (deeper work detail), directory_list_people (research a named writer by name)

identifier.description: ISWC or ISRC — direct identifier lookup

min_energy.description: Minimum energy, 0 to 1 — measured loudness, not a mood

mood.description: Mood — one of: aggressive, ambient, calm, contemplative, dark, dramatic, dreamy, energetic, epic, ethereal, hopeful, intense, melancholic, nostalgic, passionate, playful, romantic, sad, tender, tense, triumphant, uplifting, warm. "happy" is read as "uplifting". Any other word is refused. A mood matches analysed recordings, and also listed songs whose owner set that mood on audio that is not analysed: those carry mood_note "mood set by the owner, not analysed" and no measured values. With a BPM, key, energy or other measured filter, only analysed recordings match.

programmable_only.description: Only programmable works — every owner confirmed a locked split, so a licence fee is paid to each without chasing sign-off. Drops people from text results.

q.description: Free-text query (work title, creator name, etc.). Minimum 2 characters.

ready_to_license.description: Only works ready to license — composition and a master confirmed by every owner, that recording has audio and an ISRC, and the work has an ISWC. Audio results are the ready recordings themselves. Drops people from text results.

name: directory_chain
title: Rights chain for a work
